decisions.reason: As a sensor module tightly aligned with the core modular platform, management is likely to continue justifying the 2023 investment and treat any weak demand as temporary rather than withdraw it.
This industrial input module sits squarely in the established automation portfolio and the earlier visible commitment around it makes reversal unlikely without unmistakable failure.
The relay module complements the firm's control and automation ecosystem, so sunk development and production effort support keeping it on the market for longer.

Although somewhat less central than core sensing and industrial interface products, it still builds on the modular electronics offer and is recent enough for management to persist and await better uptake.
Because remote access for wallboxes directly supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy management, management is especially likely to stay committed and continue the service.
